name: Multi-Lingual Catalog Routing by Detected ISO Language Code
description: Global portals store titles in multiple localized columns (title_en, title_es, title_fr). Queries are dynamically routed to the matching language column based on user locale.
prompt:
Global portals store titles in multiple localized columns (title_en, title_es, title_fr). Queries are dynamically routed to the matching language column based on user locale.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: product_id, matched_title, language_used.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Match Spanish query 'Bicicleta' routed dynamically to title_es
            SELECT 
                product_id,
                title_es AS matched_title,
                'es' AS language_used
            FROM localized_products
            WHERE title_es ILIKE '%Bicicleta%'
            ORDER BY product_id;
why_it_fails: Searching across all language columns simultaneously creates false-positive matches due to inter-language false cognates.
